messages:
Maya (RevOps): Quick heads-up: APAC inbound shows surge in unassigned leads; HS->SF handoff logs show enrichment timeouts causing round-robin to skip. Can we triage?
Alec (Growth): Noticed conversion dip on the dashboard. Is this related to the enrichment debounce fix?
Samir (Eng): Different. Logs: HS webhook 429s, enrichment lambda often hits 7s timeout; routing treats empty enrichment as noop.
Jordan (Ops): leadbot alerted at 02:17 local: "unassigned_rate > 0.03 inbound" :rotating_light:
Maya (RevOps): Short-term: 1) fallback default-owner after 3s, 2) heartbeat probe to nudge pending leads into low-priority RR, 3) add x-retry-count header and dashboard tile.
Samir (Eng): Patch: when enrichment exceeds 3000ms set fallback_owner="sdr-inbound@redwood.com" and source="fallback". Will add retry/backoff on webhook: attempts=4, base=500ms, max=5s.
Alec (Growth): Ok as stopgap. Need comms: banner + playbook so SDRs know fallbacks are temporary.
Jordan (Ops): Heartbeat idea: every 10s find leads with state='pending_enrichment' and age>12s then POST to /routing/round_robin?priority=low.
Maya (RevOps): Metrics: leads_fallback_count, leads_reassigned_24h. Alert if fallback_rate > 2% for 20m.
Samir (Eng): I'll open PR with tests and tag @Maya for rollout. Canary 10% for 2h, synthetic slow events, then promote if metrics look normal.
Alec (Growth): I'll draft banner + 1-pager about SLA impact.
leadbot: Incident created: "HS enrichment latency - fallback enabled" id:INC-318765. :white_check_mark:
Maya (RevOps): Thanks. Post-rollout: collect sample lead ids, conversion delta, and SF ownership integrity check. Ping when PR merged.
